known_pitfall_claim: For every s in S, the proof claims that (f ∨ g)(s) = max{f(x), g(x)}, despite evaluating the right-hand side at x rather than s.
pitfall_counterexample: Let the domain be Bool and codomain Nat, with function join defined pointwise by max. Take S = {false}, s = false, x = true, f(false)=0, f(true)=2, and g(false)=g(true)=0.
